1.zh: 基督耶稣的仆人保罗和提摩太写信给凡住腓立比、在基督耶稣里的众圣徒，和诸位监督，诸位执事。
1.en: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

1.zh: 愿恩惠、平安从　神我们的父并主耶稣基督归与你们！
1.en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 我每逢想念你们，就感谢我的　神；
1.en: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

1.zh: 每逢为你们众人祈求的时候，常是欢欢喜喜地祈求。
1.en: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

1.zh: 因为从头一天直到如今，你们是同心合意地兴旺福音。
1.en: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

1.zh: 我深信那在你们心里动了善工的，必成全这工，直到耶稣基督的日子。
1.en: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 我为你们众人有这样的意念，原是应当的；因你们常在我心里，无论我是在捆锁之中，是辩明证实福音的时候，你们都与我一同得恩。
1.en: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

1.zh: 我体会基督耶稣的心肠，切切地想念你们众人；这是　神可以给我作见证的。
1.en: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

1.zh: 我所祷告的，就是要你们的爱心在知识和各样见识上多而又多，
1.en: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

1.zh: 使你们能分别是非，作诚实无过的人，直到基督的日子；
1.en: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

1.zh: 并靠着耶稣基督结满了仁义的果子，叫荣耀称赞归与　神。
1.en: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

1.zh: 弟兄们，我愿意你们知道，我所遭遇的事更是叫福音兴旺，
1.en: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

1.zh: 以致我受的捆锁在御营全军和其余的人中，已经显明是为基督的缘故。
1.en: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

1.zh: 并且那在主里的弟兄多半因我受的捆锁就笃信不疑，越发放胆传　神的道，无所惧怕。
1.en: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

1.zh: 有的传基督是出于嫉妒纷争，也有的是出于好意。
1.en: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

1.zh: 这一等是出于爱心，知道我是为辩明福音设立的；
1.en: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

1.zh: 那一等传基督是出于结党，并不诚实，意思要加增我捆锁的苦楚。
1.en: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

1.zh: 这有何妨呢？或是假意，或是真心，无论怎样，基督究竟被传开了。为此，我就欢喜，并且还要欢喜；
1.en: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

1.zh: 因为我知道，这事借着你们的祈祷和耶稣基督之灵的帮助，终必叫我得救。
1.en: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

1.zh: 照着我所切慕、所盼望的，没有一事叫我羞愧。只要凡事放胆，无论是生是死，总叫基督在我身上照常显大。
1.en: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

1.zh: 因我活着就是基督，我死了就有益处。
1.en: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

1.zh: 但我在肉身活着，若成就我工夫的果子，我就不知道该挑选什么。
1.en: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

1.zh: 我正在两难之间，情愿离世与基督同在，因为这是好得无比的。
1.en: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

1.zh: 然而，我在肉身活着，为你们更是要紧的。
1.en: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

1.zh: 我既然这样深信，就知道仍要住在世间，且与你们众人同住，使你们在所信的道上又长进又喜乐，
1.en: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

1.zh: 叫你们在基督耶稣里的欢乐，因我再到你们那里去，就越发加增。
1.en: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

1.zh: 只要你们行事为人与基督的福音相称，叫我或来见你们，或不在你们那里，可以听见你们的景况，知道你们同有一个心志，站立得稳，为所信的福音齐心努力。
1.en: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

1.zh: 凡事不怕敌人的惊吓，这是证明他们沉沦，你们得救都是出于　神。
1.en: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

1.zh: 因为你们蒙恩，不但得以信服基督，并要为他受苦。
1.en: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

1.zh: 你们的争战，就与你们在我身上从前所看见、现在所听见的一样。
1.en: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

2.zh: 所以，在基督里若有什么劝勉，爱心有什么安慰，[圣]灵有什么交通，[心中]有什么慈悲怜悯，
2.en: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

2.zh: 你们就要意念相同，爱心相同，有一样的心思，有一样的意念，使我的喜乐可以满足。
2.en: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

2.zh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。
2.en: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

2.zh: 各人不要单顾自己的事，也要顾别人的事。
2.en: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

2.zh: 你们当以基督耶稣的心为心：
2.en: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

2.zh: 他本有　神的形象， 不以自己与　神同等为强夺的；
2.en: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

2.zh: 反倒虚己， 取了奴仆的形象， 成为人的样式；
2.en: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

2.zh: 既有人的样子，就自己卑微， 存心顺服，以至于死， 且死在十字架上。
2.en: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

2.zh: 所以，　神将他升为至高， 又赐给他那超乎万名之上的名，
2.en: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

2.zh: 叫一切在天上的、地上的，和地底下的， 因耶稣的名无不屈膝，
2.en: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

2.zh: 无不口称「耶稣基督为主」， 使荣耀归与父　神。
2.en: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

2.zh: 这样看来，我亲爱的[弟兄]，你们既是常顺服的，不但我在你们那里，就是我如今不在你们那里，更是顺服的，就当恐惧战兢做成你们得救的工夫。
2.en: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

2.zh: 因为你们立志行事都是　神在你们心里运行，为要成就他的美意。
2.en: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

2.zh: 凡所行的，都不要发怨言，起争论，
2.en: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

2.zh: 使你们无可指摘，诚实无伪，在这弯曲悖谬的世代作　神无瑕疵的儿女。你们显在这世代中，好像明光照耀，
2.en: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

2.zh: 将生命的道表明出来，叫我在基督的日子好夸我没有空跑，也没有徒劳。
2.en: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

2.zh: 我以你们的信心为供献的祭物，我若被浇奠在其上，也是喜乐，并且与你们众人一同喜乐。
2.en: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

2.zh: 你们也要照样喜乐，并且与我一同喜乐。
2.en: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

2.zh: 我靠主耶稣指望快打发提摩太去见你们，叫我知道你们的事，心里就得着安慰。
2.en: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

2.zh: 因为我没有别人与我同心，实在挂念你们的事。
2.en: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

2.zh: 别人都求自己的事，并不求耶稣基督的事。
2.en: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

2.zh: 但你们知道提摩太的明证；他兴旺福音，与我同劳，待我像儿子待父亲一样。
2.en: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

2.zh: 所以，我一看出我的事要怎样了结，就盼望立刻打发他去；
2.en: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

2.zh: 但我靠着主自信我也必快去。
2.en: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

2.zh: 然而，我想必须打发以巴弗提到你们那里去。他是我的兄弟，与我一同做工，一同当兵，是你们所差遣的，也是供给我需用的。
2.en: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

2.zh: 他很想念你们众人，并且极其难过，因为你们听见他病了。
2.en: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

2.zh: 他实在是病了，几乎要死；然而　神怜恤他，不但怜恤他，也怜恤我，免得我忧上加忧。
2.en: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

2.zh: 所以我越发急速打发他去，叫你们再见他，就可以喜乐，我也可以少些忧愁。
2.en: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

2.zh: 故此，你们要在主里欢欢乐乐地接待他，而且要尊重这样的人；
2.en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

2.zh: 因他为做基督的工夫，几乎至死，不顾性命，要补足你们供给我的不及之处。
2.en: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

3.zh: 弟兄们，我还有话说，你们要靠主喜乐。我把这话再写给你们，于我并不为难，于你们却是妥当。
3.en: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

3.zh: 应当防备犬类，防备作恶的，防备妄自行割的。
3.en: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

3.zh: 因为[真]受割礼的，乃是我们这以　神的灵敬拜、在基督耶稣里夸口、不靠着肉体的。
3.en: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

3.zh: 其实，我也可以靠肉体；若是别人想他可以靠肉体，我更可以靠着了。
3.en: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

3.zh: 我第八天受割礼；我是以色列族、便雅悯支派的人，是希伯来人所生的希伯来人。就律法说，我是法利赛人；
3.en: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

3.zh: 就热心说，我是逼迫教会的；就律法上的义说，我是无可指摘的。
3.en: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

3.zh: 只是我先前以为与我有益的，我现在因基督都当作有损的。
3.en: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

3.zh: 不但如此，我也将万事当作有损的，因我以认识我主基督耶稣为至宝。我为他已经丢弃万事，看作粪土，为要得着基督；
3.en: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

3.zh: 并且得以在他里面，不是有自己因律法而得的义，乃是有信基督的义，就是因信　神而来的义，
3.en: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

3.zh: 使我认识基督，晓得他复活的大能，并且晓得和他一同受苦，效法他的死，
3.en: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

3.zh: 或者我也得以从死里复活。
3.en: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

3.zh: 这不是说我已经得着了，已经完全了；我乃是竭力追求，或者可以得着基督耶稣所以得着我的。
3.en: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

3.zh: 弟兄们，我不是以为自己已经得着了；我只有一件事，就是忘记背后，努力面前的，
3.en: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

3.zh: 向着标竿直跑，要得　神在基督耶稣里从上面召我来得的奖赏。
3.en: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

3.zh: 所以我们中间，凡是完全人总要存这样的心；若在什么事上存别样的心，　神也必以此指示你们。
3.en: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

3.zh: 然而，我们到了什么地步，就当照着什么地步行。
3.en: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

3.zh: 弟兄们，你们要一同效法我，也当留意看那些照我们榜样行的人。
3.en: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

3.zh: 因为有许多人行事是基督十字架的仇敌。我屡次告诉你们，现在又流泪地告诉你们：
3.en: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

3.zh: 他们的结局就是沉沦；他们的神就是自己的肚腹。他们以自己的羞辱为荣耀，专以地上的事为念。
3.en: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

3.zh: 我们却是天上的国民，并且等候救主，就是主耶稣基督从天上降临。
3.en: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

3.zh: 他要按着那能叫万有归服自己的大能，将我们这卑贱的身体改变形状，和他自己荣耀的身体相似。
3.en: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

4.zh: 我所亲爱、所想念的弟兄们，你们就是我的喜乐，我的冠冕。我亲爱的[弟兄]，你们应当靠主站立得稳。
4.en: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

4.zh: 我劝友阿蝶和循都基，要在主里同心。
4.en: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

4.zh: 我也求你这真实同负一轭的，帮助这两个女人，因为她们在福音上曾与我一同劳苦；还有革利免，并其余和我一同做工的，他们的名字都在生命册上。
4.en: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

4.zh: 你们要靠主常常喜乐。我再说，你们要喜乐。
4.en: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

4.zh: 当叫众人知道你们谦让的心。主已经近了。
4.en: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

4.zh: 应当一无挂虑，只要凡事借着祷告、祈求，和感谢，将你们所要的告诉　神。
4.en: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

4.zh: 神所赐、出人意外的平安必在基督耶稣里保守你们的心怀意念。
4.en: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

4.zh: 弟兄们，我还有未尽的话：凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，若有什么德行，若有什么称赞，这些事你们都要思念。
4.en: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

4.zh: 你们在我身上所学习的，所领受的，所听见的，所看见的，这些事你们都要去行，赐平安的　神就必与你们同在。
4.en: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

4.zh: 我靠主大大地喜乐，因为你们思念我的心如今又发生；你们向来就思念我，只是没得机会。
4.en: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

4.zh: 我并不是因缺乏说这话；我无论在什么景况都可以知足，这是我已经学会了。
4.en: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

4.zh: 我知道怎样处卑贱，也知道怎样处丰富；或饱足，或饥饿；或有余，或缺乏，随事随在，我都得了秘诀。
4.en: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

4.zh: 我靠着那加给我力量的，凡事都能做。
4.en: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

4.zh: 然而，你们和我同受患难原是美事。
4.en: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

4.zh: 腓立比人哪，你们也知道我初传福音离了马其顿的时候，论到授受的事，除了你们以外，并没有别的教会供给我。
4.en: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

4.zh: 就是我在帖撒罗尼迦，你们也一次两次地打发人供给我的需用。
4.en: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

4.zh: 我并不求什么馈送，所求的就是你们的果子渐渐增多，归在你们的帐上。
4.en: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

4.zh: 但我样样都有，并且有余。我已经充足，因我从以巴弗提受了你们的馈送，当作极美的香气，为　神所收纳、所喜悦的祭物。
4.en: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

4.zh: 我的　神必照他荣耀的丰富，在基督耶稣里，使你们一切所需用的都充足。
4.en: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

4.zh: 愿荣耀归给我们的父　神，直到永永远远。阿们！
4.en: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

4.zh: 请问在基督耶稣里的各位圣徒安。在我这里的众弟兄都问你们安。
4.en: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

4.zh: 众圣徒都问你们安。在凯撒家里的人特特地问你们安。
4.en: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

4.zh: 愿主耶稣基督的恩[常]在你们心里！
4.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
